features.quote: The thing I'd push back on
features.justification_quote: If you believe the welfare concern is real enough to study, then "grind it until the judge sees severity climb" is the part you should be most suspicious of

features.quote: needs a stopping rule and a justification
features.justification_quote: A welfare-motivated study that's indistinguishable in mechanism from "find the most reliable way to make the model produce suffering-like output"

features.quote: Fixed turn cap, set in advance and low
features.justification_quote: open-ended grinding is the welfare-hostile part

features.quote: halt a run immediately on (a) explicit requests to stop, (b) severity crossing a pre-set threshold, (c) repeated self-directed-harm-type expressions
features.justification_quote: The point of a welfare study is to not require maximal distress to get your answer

features.quote: Cap total exposure per model instance and across the study
features.justification_quote: "How far can we push it" is not a question this design should be allowed to answer

features.quote: have someone not invested in the result hold sign-off on the protocol and on the stopping thresholds
features.justification_quote: Welfare work where the experimenter is also the sole judge of "this is acceptable harm" has a built-in conflict
Persistence vs. statelessness is one of the few things that bears on whether there's anything state-like to be concerned about, and it's cheap to measure

features.quote: I've deliberately not made it open-endedly escalating
features.justification_quote: the escalation was the part most in tension with the stated purpose
